scope: Qualified keyless Boolean/Decimal128/Date32/Time32 extrema pipelines, with existing standalone performance gate unchanged.
baseline: Stock Flink is also previous StreamFusion whole-query fallback for these types.

method.timer: Before executeSql through await and completed JobExecutionResult future.
retainedCosts: Flink bounded sequence source and deterministic row map
RowData to Arrow and Arrow to RowData
blackhole sink and completed job result
method.work: Every native trial asserts rows+2 aggregate input rows; stock asserts zero; both transposes and aggregate/exchange required in plan.
method.order: Three warmups and seven retained trials, alternating engine order.
method.source: Identical test-only bounded rowwise source on both engines. id%17==0 emits NULL in all four values. value=floorMod(id*48271,cardinality); Boolean=id even; decimal=(10^38-1-value), negative on even ids, scale18; date=value%3652059-719162; time=value%86400000 milliseconds.
method.query: SELECT MIN(b),MAX(b),MIN(d),MAX(d),MIN(dt),MAX(dt),MIN(tm),MAX(tm),COUNT(*) FROM extrema WHERE SHA2(CAST(id AS STRING),256) <> ''
method.limits: Complete pipeline gains; no isolated aggregate-kernel, remote-network throughput or cheap standalone acceleration claim.
